settings.text: Which one is right for my skin type: OS-01 FACE RICH CREAM or OS-01 FACE MOISTURIZER?

settings.repere: Texte · OS-01 FACE MOISTURIZER provides lightw…
settings.text: OS-01 FACE MOISTURIZER provides lightweight hydration and is suitable for oily, combination, and normal skin. OS-01 FACE RICH CREAM delivers deep hydration in a rich, replenishing texture and is suitable for dry, depleted, or mature skin. As seasons and climates change, you may choose to switch between the two depending on your hydration needs.

settings.text: With twice-daily use, one 50ml jar should last approximately 1–2 months. This varies from person to person depending on how much you use per application, but many people find that 1–2 pumps generously cover the face and neck.

settings.text: Can I wear OS-01 FACE RICH CREAM under makeup during the day, or is it strictly a night cream?

settings.text: OS-01 FACE RICH CREAM can be used day and night, depending on your skin's needs. You can use OS-01 FACE MOISTURIZER as a lightweight daytime moisturizer and OS-01 FACE RICH CREAM as a night cream—or use OS-01 FACE RICH CREAM morning and evening if you have dry, depleted skin, are in a dry climate or season, or just want a little extra hydration.

settings.text: OS-01 FACE RICH CREAM can work well under makeup, but we always recommend patch testing with your specific makeup to ensure the combination works well for you. We recommend giving it a few minutes to fully absorb before applying makeup on top.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · IS OS-01 FACE RICH CREAM safe for sens…
settings.text: IS OS-01 FACE RICH CREAM safe for sensitive skin?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · OS-01 FACE RICH CREAM is suitable for …
settings.text: OS-01 FACE RICH CREAM is suitable for sensitive skin, non-comedogenic, dermatologist tested, fragrance free, and formulated without parabens, sulfates, phthalates, or other common irritants. Based on its formula and clinical testing, it has been awarded the National Eczema Association Seal of Acceptance™. Additionally, it contains barrier-supporting and hydrating ingredients, including a Triple Lipid Barrier Complex (ceramides, cholesterol, and free fatty acids), ectoin, and tremella mushroom extract—ingredients generally recognized for their gentle and soothing properties. In consumer testing, 87% of users agreed the cream deeply moisturizes and comforts dry skin.1

settings.repere: Paragraphe · That said, as with any new skincare pr…
settings.text: That said, as with any new skincare product, we recommend patch testing before full application, especially for those with known sensitivities or reactive skin conditions.
